EmailTemplate.subject: You're Invited: The Future of Payments in Higher Education Webinar

The Future of Payments in Higher Education: Efficiency, Localisation and Cost Savings
Wednesday 2nd July | 2pm SGT We’re excited to invite you to an exclusive webinar exploring The Future of Payments in Higher Education—a discussion on modernising payment management and removing barriers for international transactions.
Date: Wednesday, 2nd July 2025
Time: 2pm Singapore Time
Register now! <[[https://xetta.pub/Flywire]]>
Join us to discover:
- How a unified and integrated systems drive efficiency, improve cash flow, and streamline reporting - Why adopting local payment methods (Alipay, WeChat Pay, etc) enhances the experience for international students and makes your institution more attractive globally - How operational efficiency in payments frees up resources for student services and academic programmes
Hear insights from Guy St Clair, Senior Director, Sales & Client Services, JAPAC EDU at Flywire, as well as Pradeep Nair, Regional Sales Manager, APAC at xetta.
Don’t miss this opportunity to gain valuable knowledge and practical strategies to modernise your institution’s payment management.
Register now! <[[https://xetta.pub/Flywire]]>
We look forward to seeing you there!
